steps: Go to https://panels.nielsen.com and find the Computer & Mobile Panel signup.
If accepted, download and install the Nielsen panel software on your phone and/or computer.
Keep the software installed and running; it passively records your online activity in the background.
Log in to the Nielsen rewards portal (https://computermobilepanelrewards.nielsen.com/) to track points.
Redeem accumulated points for the available rewards (gift cards, vouchers, or physical items).
NOTE: official terms state no concrete point rates or minimums — treat all third-party earning figures (e.g. '$5-$10 every few months') as unverified.
